Definition: from G4506; a fold (as drawing together), i.e. a wrinkle (especially on the face):--wrinkle.
BiblicalUsage: Rhytís is the word for a fold (as drawing together), that is a wrinkle (especially on the face). It stands in Ephesians 5:27: "…to himself a glorious church, not having spot…".
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that one mention of rhytís is enough, because God wastes no words.
